system_prompt: Answer the spoken question with one color word.

patch_windows.word_local: encoder rows whose nominal center lies in fixed spliced word-slot interval
patch_windows.changed_chunk: all encoder rows in the 200-mel-frame self-attention chunk containing the word-slot center
patch_windows.wrong_chunk: same number of rows as word_local, taken from the earliest different self-attention chunk

primary_endpoint: complete decoded answer exactly equals the donor color, with normal EOS
interpretation_limit: Post-attention encoder rows can mix information across their entire chunk. A word-local row swap is an intervention on indexed states, not proof that those rows encode only the word.
